summary.en: Takagi and Sato begin questioning the suspects, all of which wandered around the area separately so they did not have clear alibis. Meanwhile, Kobayashi’s group decides to have a rest at a room that is under maintenance since it is quite late now and they came here by walking. There, Conan has to share to everyone else about his unusual feelings toward the suspects as they appeared awkward when the name Katsumine was mentioned, he also suggests that the murder could continue and it’s up to them to stop it at all cost. So Kobayashi decides to inform the police about the person named Katsumine. Fortunately, the police are ahead of the curve this time as they have gathered information about the person named Katsumine since the beginning of the investigation into this case. And it is known that he died due to drowning 2 years ago, but then there were many anonymous letters sent to the local police claiming that Katsumine had been murdered and asking for the incident to be reinvestigated. In addition, on the day of his death, he had been drinking with the two recent strangulation victims, but they had an alibi for the time of Katsumine's death. At the same time, Takagi enters and offers to take them home before tomorrow’s interrogation, but Conan asks Takagi about the blood on Okumoto's right finger, to which he replies that it was the victim's own and questions why the boy asked. It seems that he will be caught up in a new task to catch the culprit led by Conan tonight.
